name: Poly Haven
description: Free CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures and photoscanned 3D models with a public API.

name: ambientCG
description: Free CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs, decals and atlases (1K-16K) with a public JSON API and direct downloads.

name: cgbookcase
description: Free CC0 PBR textures up to 8K (scanned, procedural and approximated).

name: ShareTextures
description: Free CC0-style PBR textures, scanned 3D models and atlases (search by tag; download on the site).

name: BlenderKit
description: Blender-native models, materials, HDRIs, scenes and brushes (free + Full Plan) with a public search API; free assets download as .blend/.glb.

name: Fab
description: Epic's marketplace (formerly Unreal Marketplace, Sketchfab Store, Quixel): game-ready models, environments, characters, materials.

name: Kenney
description: Hundreds of CC0 game asset packs (low-poly 3D kits, 2D sprites, UI, audio, fonts) by Kenney.

name: Poliigon
description: Premium photoreal PBR materials, HDRIs and models (subscription, with a free selection).

name: Quaternius
description: Free low-poly 3D model packs and animated, rigged characters by Quaternius (CC0 or the similar QAL).

name: Polyfork
description: Low-poly, game- and web-ready 3D models (props, buildings, vehicles, characters, themed kits) with a public API; free assets download as GLB.

name: 3DAssets.dev
description: Open catalogue of web-optimised CC0 GLB models (props, nature, buildings, vehicles, characters) with a public API.

name: Grab3D
description: Free CC0 3D models (GLB, FBX, Blender, USDZ, OBJ) with PBR textures: props, characters, vehicles, nature, buildings.

name: Scenario 3D Collection
description: About 1,300 AI-generated 3D models (GLB, Blend, FBX, voxels, Gaussian splats) from Scenario, published on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0.

name: Sketchfab
description: Huge community library of 3D models (scans, props, characters, scenes); we search its CC0 public-domain models. Downloads need a Sketchfab login.

name: 3DTextures.me
description: Free CC0 seamless PBR materials, realistic and stylized (WordPress blog; downloads via Google Drive).

name: FreeStylized
description: Free stylized 3D models, PBR materials, skyboxes and asset packs (WordPress REST API; downloads via Google Drive).

name: Wikimedia Commons
description: Free 3D files (STL scans, anatomy, reconstructions, printable parts) from Wikipedia's media archive; each file has its own CC0, public-domain or CC-BY(-SA) licence.

name: 3DTexel
description: Free handmade CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs, 3D assets, decals and atlases (search via its public API; download with a free account).

name: TextureCan
description: Free CC0 PBR textures (4K, many with SBSAR sources) and a few CC0 3D models, direct zip downloads.

name: OpenGameArt
description: Community game art: thousands of free 3D models, textures and 2D sprites/tilesets, each with its own licence (mostly CC0 and CC-BY).

name: Textures.com
description: Huge photo-texture library: PBR materials, scanned 3D foliage/objects, decals, ornaments and HDR skies (credit-based, daily free credits).

name: HDRMAPS
description: High-resolution HDRIs and sky domes (paid shop) plus a set of free HDRIs with direct EXR downloads.

name: HDRI Hub
description: Commercial high-resolution HDRIs, backplates and 3D people for archviz, plus a few free samples.

name: CGTrader
description: Large marketplace of free and paid 3D models (game, archviz, 3D print); downloads need a CGTrader account.

name: TurboSquid
description: Large marketplace of free and paid 3D models.

name: itch.io
description: Indie game asset packs (3D, 2D sprites, UI, audio, fonts), free and paid, from itch.io creators.
